query: Open Data Structures; Princeton sorting/priority queues; official AMD/Arm ISA manuals; Wirth author page; architecture publisher material
channel: Public primary author/university/vendor/publisher web search
decision: Choose exact official/author sources for focused inspection; ignore third-party reposts and community answers.
limitations: Search results and tables of contents establish leads, not assignable passage inspection; vendor living URLs require captured-version/hash identification.

query: What evidence supports a first-principles -> native assembly -> higher C abstraction progression without duplicating existing domains?
channel: Written reflection after broad local/library/web search
decision: Inspect a small sufficient source spine and version-specific authority; select bounded kernels and explicit ownership/cost/ABI evidence rather than two full assembly container libraries.
limitations: Progression is a design hypothesis awaiting focused passage inspection and root research gate.

query: Show seven selected named ordinary publications after broad reflection: CLRS4, Hanson CII, Knuth1, Hennessy6, Plantz ARM, Hyde x86-64, Cortex-M development guide
channel: Explicit read-only Knowledge metadata DB; ordinary PDF front matter
results: Seven identities/paths verified; no opaque payload or _old discovery.
Five books selected for bounded substantive passages; Hyde/MASM and developer-tool guide retained as rejected required-spine leads.
decision: Use selected actual editions and private fulltext search derivatives to locate bounded passages; do not equate front matter with teaching inspection.
limitations: Metadata is not fulltext evidence. Historical path aliases rebase only after current ordinary file existence; copyright and publication year differ.

query: Exact insertion invariant, RAM model, heap moving violation, probe/deletion, BFS frontier/proof, naive matcher; Hanson interfaces and client contract; Knuth AlgorithmE
channel: Held ordinary PDF bounded reading
decision: Expand exact existing CLRS/Hanson locator scopes and add bounded Knuth resource; reuse accepted Morin/Dijkstra/Hoare passages.
limitations: No full-book inspection. CLRS formulas in some PDF text are incomplete; readable proof argument scope is disclosed. Historical C arithmetic is not modern C17 semantics.

query: Quantitative performance, AMAT, cache tags/replacement/miss categories, RAW forwarding; adder and clocked-state mechanisms
channel: Held ordinary PDF bounded reading
decision: Select declared educational architecture models, derive original independent numerical fixtures, separate A64 and Thumb.
limitations: Held numeric examples include inconsistent frequency/time or penalty inputs. Toy/RISC/AMAT models are not actual x86/MCU performance specifications.

query: ISBN9780128119051 publication date; Plantz ARM publication date
channel: Primary publisher web
results: Elsevier Educate specifies23Nov2017 for SixthEdition ISBN9780128119051.
NoStarch ARM edition page specifiesDecember2024, ISBN9781718502741.
decision: Resolve bibliographic years to2017 and2024 while retaining held copyright dates2019 and2025 as distinct evidence.
limitations: Publisher contents do not expand assigned inspection scopes. Initial guessed Plantz URL replaced by actual canonical publisher URL.

query: Dijkstra1959 original shortest paths; Adelson-Velskii/Landis1962 original origin record
channel: Primary institutional publication archives
results: CWI publication9256 and original3pagePDF inspected and hashed.
MathNet dan26964 identifies Russian original pp263–266; bibliographic view only.
decision: Assign Dijkstra Problem2 original-set mechanism; retain AVL origin as nonassignable lineage lead.
limitations: An initial guessed Dijkstra EWD23 URL returned404 and was not retried; correct CWI primary found. AVL original was not translated/read. Connected historical graph needs explicit modern nonnegative/disconnected/overflow contracts.

query: Official Intel SDM current version and scalar register/address/CMP/Jcc passages
channel: Intel primary manual page and CDN captures
results: Official page identifies093; revision093 Vol1 andVol2A captured and hashed.
decision: Pin093; actual instruction bits and signed/unsigned predicates support small hand-written scalar kernels.
limitations: web PDF click could not fetch redirect; direct official CDN byte capture succeeded. Earlier guessed AMD vendor PDF URLs returned404 and were not retried. Intel semantics are not timing or C memory permissions.

query: Arm ABI2025Q1; Cortex-M4 instruction widths/load/store/CMP/branch; Armv7-M Thumb compare bitfields
channel: Arm primary release repository and exact official manuals
results: AAPCS32 release2025Q1 rawRST capture, commitc51addc3dc03e73a016a1e4edf25440bcac76431, register/stack scope.
Existing DUI0553B bytes reused with new exact instruction passages.
DDI0403E.e official PDF captured; width discriminator andCMP-T1 bitfield page read and locally rendered.
decision: Use Cortex-M4 Thumb base scalar PCS; distinguish call preservation, flag lifetimes and actual machine encodings.
limitations: Arm support HTML parsed no content and one guessed static URL failed; correct vendor URL was found. A web screenshot timed out; successful local render supplied bitfield visual inspection. No VFP/aggregate/variadic or optional extension blanket claim.

query: STM32F4 CPU/DMA master targets, CCM, arbitration and APB bridge constraints
channel: Existing root-captured primary RM0090 Rev21 PDF
results: SHA e34807b876642b67a6208e6e4071694f2892b5df088ef89f49cdad5cb254165f verified; exact pp59–64 scoped text read.
decision: Expand existing Rev21 record for selected-part reachability and static placement evidence.
limitations: Do not relabel Rev22 or infer electrical timing/throughput. Board/datasheet/errata and actual transfer observations remain separate.
